description: This file defines an abstract class 'RegexBasedAbstract' in the 'FastRoute\DataGenerator' namespace. It provides the core logic for managing static and variable routes in a routing system, including adding routes, generating route data, and handling regex building and validation.

classes.name: RegexBasedAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class that provides core functionalities for route data generation based on regex patterns, managing static and dynamic routes in a routing system.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route for a specific HTTP method; delegates to static or variable route addition based on route data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current route data as an array containing static routes and variable route data.

methods.name: generateVariableRouteData
methods.description: Processes and generates route data for variable routes, chunking the data for efficiency.

methods.name: computeChunkSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of chunks to split route data for processing, based on an approximate chunk size.

methods.name: isStaticRoute
methods.description: Determines whether a route is static based on its route data structure.

methods.name: addStaticRoute
methods.description: Registers a static route, throwing exceptions if conflicts are detected.

methods.name: addVariableRoute
methods.description: Registers a variable (dynamic) route with regex and variables, throwing exceptions if conflicts are detected.

methods.name: buildRegexForRoute
methods.description: Builds a regex pattern and its associated variables for a route, validating for duplicates and capturing groups.

methods.name: regexHasCapturingGroups
methods.description: Detects whether a regex pattern contains capturing groups to prevent conflicts.
